_comment: Model replies RECORDED for the default objective. The tools run for real against the database; only the model's decisions come from here. Each agent makes one mistake on purpose so you can see the reject -> fix cycle.

segmentation.text: Before writing SQL, I will read the catalogue to confirm how 'first rental' is defined and which columns exist.
First rental = exactly 1 row in rentals. I will count these customers by how long ago they returned the car and by whether they have the app, to see how big each slice is.

input.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN d <= 90 THEN '030-090' WHEN d <= 180 THEN '091-180' ELSE '181+' END AS bucket,
       c.has_app,
       COUNT(*) AS n
FROM (
    SELECT customer_id,
           julianday(date('2026-10-19')) - julianday(MAX(return_date)) AS d
    FROM rentals
    GROUP BY customer_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
) f
JOIN customers c USING (customer_id)
WHERE d >= 30
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

segmentation.text: The objective says 1 to 3 months and app adoption. First attempt: only people without the app, returned 30-90 days ago. That is 518 before exclusions; it may come up short, but it is the closest match to the request.

input.name: first_rental_30_90d_no_app
input.sql:
SELECT r.customer_id
FROM rentals r
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id
WHERE c.has_app = 0
  AND r.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM rentals GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 1)
  AND julianday(date('2026-10-19')) - julianday(r.return_date) BETWEEN 30 AND 90
input.rationale: Customers with a single rental, returned 30-90 days ago, without the app. This is the slice closest to the request.

segmentation.text: Rejected: after consent and fatigue 340 remain, below the minimum of 600 for an A/B test. I have two levers: widen the window or include people with the app. Including app users even helps the test (I can compare), and widening to 180 days keeps customers still 'warm'. I will do both and leave has_app as a dimension for the content, not as a filter.

input.name: first_rental_30_180d
input.sql:
SELECT r.customer_id
FROM rentals r
WHERE r.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM rentals GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 1)
  AND julianday(date('2026-10-19')) - julianday(r.return_date) BETWEEN 30 AND 180
input.rationale: Customers with a single rental returned 30-180 days ago. I widened from 90 to 180 days and included people who already have the app, because the no-app 90-day slice gave 340 after exclusions, not enough to test. App adoption is now handled in the content, not in the filter.

content.text: I need to understand who is in the segment and what the brand rules are. I will ask for both at once.

Profile: ~1.2k customers, 60% without the app, 60% picked up at an airport, mostly economy/compact, booked mostly on the web. Hypotheses: (A) a simple reminder as baseline; (B) personalising with the last city adds relevance; (C) an app-only incentive converts and pushes adoption. First draft of C:

variant.hypothesis: An app-only incentive drives the second rental and app adoption.
variant.subject: 20% off your next trip + a free upgrade, only in the app
variant.preheader: Book your second rental in our app.
variant.body: Hi {{first_name}}, your next trip deserves a head start. Download the app and save on your second rental.

content.text: The linter caught three problems: subject too long, 20% above the 15% maximum, and the term 'free'. I change it to 10%, drop the upgrade and shorten it. Submitting the three variants.

variants.hypothesis: Baseline: a plain brand reminder with no incentive or personalisation.
variants.subject: Ready for your next trip, {{first_name}}?
variants.preheader: Your next car is a few taps away.
variants.body: Hi {{first_name}}, thanks for travelling with us. Wherever you are heading next, we have a car ready at branches across Europe. Pick it up at the airport or in town, and get on the road in minutes.

variants.hypothesis: Referencing the last city and car class makes the message feel relevant and lifts conversion.
variants.subject: {{first_name}}, back to {{last_city}} soon?
variants.preheader: Your {{last_vehicle_class}} is ready when you are.
variants.body: Hi {{first_name}}, last time you picked up a {{last_vehicle_class}} in {{last_city}}. Heading back, or somewhere new? Book in under a minute and pick up right where you left off.

variants.hypothesis: An app-only incentive drives the second rental and app adoption.
variants.subject: 10% off your second trip, in the app
variants.preheader: Book your next rental in our app and save.
variants.body: Hi {{first_name}}, your next trip deserves a head start. Book your second rental in our app and save 10%. Manage your booking, skip the counter and unlock your car from your phone.
